explanation: Perform a depth-first traversal and append each value in preorder order. Null children contribute no values.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion space plus O(n) output space.
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract; EPI problem attribution remains in the collection.
correctness: At a nonempty subtree, append its root before entering either child. Recursive induction then supplies the complete left subtree in preorder, followed by the complete right subtree in preorder. This is exactly root-left-right traversal, and each node belongs to only one recursive call.
walkthrough: For [16, 7, 25, 2, 11, null, 30], emit root 16, then the left subtree sequence 7, 2, 11, then the right subtree sequence 25, 30. Return [16, 7, 2, 11, 25, 30].
edgeCases: A right-only child is visited after its parent without requiring a left placeholder in the output.
Repeated values are retained as separate node visits.
